title: feat(seedclass): classify one-site seeds on the two-cube
science: Bounded_theorem note, no probe cell. Complete CLASSIFICATION of all twelve single-site seeds on the two-cube under the L0 occupancy step: the census is 4+4+4 by seed x-coordinate, with A-only (x=0) and B-only (x=2) seeds each forming exactly 3 sites and shared-face (x=1) seeds each forming exactly 4. The derived rule is that the first-wave formation count equals the number of ON-PATCH nearest neighbors of the seed, so it is a boundary/coordination-number effect, not a property of the seed's cube membership. Modest but exhaustive. 12/12 runner PASS.
verdict_pair: none in diff (no reverse/face verdicts; runner TOTAL: PASS=12 FAIL=0)
